notifications.title: A published Short shows the same amount two different ways
notifications.detail: v-20261017-04 ('How much do impulse orders really cost you in 15 years?') shows '₹6.5 L gone' at 15.9 s but 'Put in ₹6.4 L' at 26.7 s, and 'Worth ₹16.3 L' at 26.7 s but '₹16.5 L' on the bar at 32.2 s. It was made by the old money_leak_meter template, which no longer exists, so new videos aren't affected; the improver has an adopt proposal (same-figure-same-text) for a check that stops this happening again.
notifications.fix: Only the owner handles uploads: in YouTube Studio, open that Short and either set it to Private/Unlisted or leave it up (the gap is a rounding and convention difference, not a wrong claim). Nothing to change in the repo.

notifications.title: Claude Code 2.1.302: a routine's page now says why its last run didn't start
notifications.detail: If a video or agent run is ever missing, the routine's page on claude.ai/code shows a banner with the reason (for example the concurrent cloud session limit). With 04:07, 06:17 and 07:37 runs close together, check this first.
notifications.fix: Nothing to do now. When a run is missing, open claude.ai/code → Routines → the routine and read the banner.
